newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound averages 3.39238/3.39425 to dlr.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound averages 3.39238/3.39425 to dlr.

text.p: Private sector Egyptian banks said the dollar ranged from 3.3915 to 3.3930 pounds bid and 3.3925 to 3.3950 pounds offered in the interbank market on Tuesday.
A survey of four actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.39238 bid and 3.39425 offered compared to 3.3931 bid and 3.3951 offered on Monday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.391344 buy and 3.396999 sell.
